name: Tempered Grasp
description: Let open meridians carry qi to the fingerplates as the straight fist leaves the shoulder.

name: Iron Knucklecap
description: Thrust the braced cuff out ahead of the body so a charge breaks against the steel.

name: Granite Palmguard
description: Step diagonally behind the raised backplate to leave the line of an incoming thrust.

name: Blazemitt
description: Whip the loose wrist so the steel backplate cracks across the opponent's temple.

name: Skinning Vambrace
description: Run a pulse of qi down the rear arm so the crossing steel fist lands harder than it looks.

name: Gyve Thumbplate
description: Turn the cuff over an opponent's forearm and lock it there while qi keeps the hold tight.

name: Rumble Seizeup
description: Drive the fingerplates in a tight spiral so the blow splits a breastplate seam instead of denting it.

name: Stifling Deed Wristcuff
description: Press steel thumb and fingers on the nerve points of an arm and seal its qi flow for a few breaths.

name: Mittassault
description: Tap the steel fist repeatedly on one rivet of the armor to work it loose.

name: Facet Cuffplate
description: Brace the dented backplate against the shoulder to take a blow on the thickest steel.

name: Silt Wring
description: Shuffle in close to an armored opponent where long weapons cannot swing freely.

name: Blaze Clamp
description: Rap the steel fist against the breastplate in short hard raps to rattle the wearer.

name: Chimegrasp
description: Wedge the steel fingers into an armor seam and pry it apart to open a gap.

name: Gust Clench
description: Strike armor with a pulse of qi so the shock passes through the metal into the wearer.

name: Clamptorment
description: Lower the armored shoulder behind the fist and charge to throw the opponent back.

name: Mittbarrage
description: Hook the fingerplates under an armor edge and rip with qi so the plate peels away from the wearer.

name: Raging Crushgrip
description: Hammer the helmet with a qi-struck fist so the ringing shock dazes the man beneath it.

name: Unmaking Cuffplate
description: Throw the plated fist with the qi field spread wide around the arm.

name: Granite Gauntcuff
description: Hold the cuff at the edge of the field so a blow is slowed before it reaches the steel.

name: Whipping Thumbplate
description: Count paces under the breath and glide so the gloved fist stays level over the ground.

name: Might Wristcuff
description: Press the steel palm to the chest and push through the body with a slow steady shove.

name: Blaze Seizeup
description: Throw the fist on the outbreath and draw it back on the inbreath in a steady cycle.

name: Wringassault
description: Hook the steel backplate round the guard with a push of field qi at the turn.

name: Gust Backhandplate
description: Catch a thrust on the cuff a hand's breadth before contact and turn it with the field.

name: Probing Elbowcop
description: Let the field follow the glove and feel the line of an opponent's arm through the steel.

name: Elbowcop Thrash
description: Extend the qi field a hand past the fist so the blow lands before the steel arrives.

name: Facet Palmguard
description: Lock the field around both cuffs and hold them steady against a long sustained assault.

name: Hoarfrost Fingerplate
description: Plant the feet and hold the cuff firm so the body does not rock under a blow.

name: Might Clench
description: Set heel and toes hard into the ground to refuse a push from the front.

name: Tempered Clamp
description: Turn the shoulder and shove the steel backplate into an attacker pressing at the side.

name: Granite Wring
description: Keep the fist cocked at the hip and pound it forward the instant a gap shows.

name: Steadfast Fingerplate
description: Wedge the steel forearm against a heavy swing and feed qi to the arm until the swing stops.

name: Intentclamp
description: Press down on an opponent's forearm with settled qi until the arm sags and the guard drops.

name: Mittcloak
description: Take the full force of a blow on the cuff then send it back through the fist in a single turn.

name: Aegis Knucklecap
description: Weave both cuffs in overlapping circles to stop a rain of blows from several attackers.

name: Gauntcuff Onslaught
description: Open the exchange with a lead jab while the rear gauntlet waits at the chin to answer.

name: Unyielding Vambrace
description: Drop both cuffs together to cover belly and ribs against a low thrust.

name: Torrent Crushgrip
description: Slide sideways along an imagined basin rim so the opponent must turn to follow.

name: Unmaking Seizeup
description: Brush both backplates in turn across the opponent's face so one hand always covers the other.

name: Sanguine Wring
description: Drop the fist from above the shoulder in a steep dive onto the opponent's guard.

name: Granite Crushgrip
description: Retreat in a curving line like a river bend so the pursuer overshoots.

name: Harrowing Backhandplate
description: Deflect with the lead gauntlet and strike with the rear one in one woven motion.

name: Ponderous Vambrace
description: Close both steel palms on a limb like pincers and hold it with a steady flow of qi.

name: Granite Cuffplate
description: Send one qi pulse down each arm so both fists land a heartbeat apart.

name: Rumblemitt
description: Bring both gauntlets down together like a river dropping over a ledge onto the guard.

name: Charter Wristcuff
description: Clamp both cuffs on the opponent's wrist and elbow and seal the arm's qi flow between them.

name: Sanguine Gauntcuff
description: Circle once outside the guard then stoop sharply and land the plated fist on the head.

name: Charter Knucklecap
description: Spread both cuffed arms like wings over the chest to shelter against a blow.

name: Palmguard Leap
description: Circle round the opponent in wide even steps with the gloves held low and ready.

name: Ironclench
description: Rake the curled fingerplates down the forearm like a hawk's talons on prey.

name: Gustclamp
description: Hook the backhand round the guard while the second hand moves along the other track.

name: Probing Thumbplate
description: Hold the glove still and read the opponent's weight shifts through the steel like a hawk watching.

name: Equipoise Elbowcop
description: Sweep the cuff up to turn a thrust aside and come back down on the extended arm.

name: Gyvevamb
description: Seize the exposed wrist with one glove and drop the other fist onto the elbow.

name: Grasp Thrash
description: Drive both gauntlets on two tracks to one point so the paired force punches through guard and plate.

name: Grasptorment
description: Bend the wrist like a reed in a current and tap the backplate onto the opponent's jaw.

name: Fingerplate Plating
description: Turn the cuff in a flowing curve and carry a thrust off past the hip.

name: Surging Grasp
description: Settle low into a wide stance and step in a flat line like water over a basin floor.

name: Ravaging Backhandplate
description: Press both steel palms together on the opponent's chest and push with the whole stance.

name: Charter Thumbplate
description: Tuck the elbows in tight against the ribs like banks holding a channel and absorb the hit.

name: Gust Wring
description: Skip the steel fist off the guard and over it to land a second strike on the chin.

name: Torrent Knucklecap
description: Spin the forearm in a small tight circle to catch a blade and swirl it away.

name: Gyvewring
description: Squeeze an arm between the two gloves like banks narrowing a stream and keep the pressure on.

name: Gust Fingerplate
description: Gather qi in the shoulder like rising water and release it in one hammering swing.

name: Toxingrasp
description: Hook beneath the lead arm and drag it back across the body to unbalance the stance.

name: Ironclamp
description: Gather the weight of both arms in a long breath and bring the twin gauntlets down in one crushing blow.

name: Quelling Vambrace
description: Meet both steel palms on the opponent's sternum and seal the qi where the arms' channels join.

name: Harpooning Gauntcuff
description: Jab the steel fist into the wind-line of the opponent's step as they start to advance.

name: Aegisglove
description: Hold the cuff slanted into the blow like a hull into the wind so the force slides past.

name: Mittpounce
description: Slide across open ground with no cover at all and keep the fist between body and foe.

name: Mightglove
description: Fix the gaze on one point of the opponent and drive the fist straight at it.

name: Gustglove
description: Throw the rear fist across in a strong turning surge of qi that sweeps the guard open.

name: Torrent Cuffplate
description: Turn the cuff across a swing as a sailor turns a sheet to a crosswind.

name: Hollowmitt
description: Drive the fingerplates like a wedge into a guard so the steel splits it and the force carries through.

name: Mayhemmitt
description: Sweep an open-handed guard in a wide arc to scatter oncoming blows and break the foe's line.

name: Iron Elbowcop
description: Hold a steady bearing on the opponent's chest and send the straight fist down that line.

name: Hoarfrost Wristcuff
description: Plant the cuff at the edge of the body like a cliff edge and let blows fall away past it.

name: Gustmitt
description: Step round to the sheltered side of the opponent where their long swing cannot reach.

name: Granite Seizeup
description: Keep the same heading while the backhand swings out and the steel back strikes the cheek.

name: Surging Clamp
description: Back away through open ground in a steady line with the cuffs raised against a pursuer.

name: Rumble Clench
description: Hold the bearing through the wind-up and let the plated hammer fall on the exact mark.

name: Equipoise Thumbplate
description: Feel the shift of the opponent's weight as a change in the wind and catch the swing early.

name: Charter Clench
description: Press the opponent's guard down along a steady heading and keep qi flowing in the arm.

name: Splintering Backhandplate
description: Drive the fist along a held bearing so the full force of the stance breaks through a guard.

name: Dominating Palmguard
description: Clamp the gauntlet on the opponent's arm and hold the bearing against every attempt to twist free.

name: Clamp Thrash
description: Throw the steel fist straight and true as an oath sworn to the wind.

name: Mantled Vambrace
description: Part an incoming blow with the cuff the way a prow parts a gust.

name: Blurring Clamp
description: Glide along a lane where the wind is behind and carry the fist forward with it.

name: Iron Backhandplate
description: Bring the steel fist down hard as a hammer on bare ground with nothing to hide behind.

name: Cleaving Clench
description: Hook the fist round the guard as if the wind had caught it and flung it sideways.

name: Hoarfrost Gauntcuff
description: Hold both cuffs forward and keep qi in them like a man walking into a headwind.

name: Might Elbowcop
description: Push off the rear foot with a pulse of qi and surge forward as if driven by a tailwind.

name: Needling Crushgrip
description: Burst the gathered qi through the fingerplates in a single storm-force thrust that breaks plate and bone.

name: Graspcloak
description: Lay the steel palm on the opponent's forearm and seal its qi as a gale seals a sail.
